text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, while walking down a tree-lined 
path, I spotted Admire Vega standing at 
the edge of the road.

text_block_list.name: Kittens
text_block_list.text: Myaaoo♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking in the direction of her gaze, two 
kittens—likely siblings—were playing 
together. Watching them, her expression 
seemed somewhat gentle.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Not really. It's not like that.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With those words, Admire Vega walked away 
before I could say anything else.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: That evening—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
She still hasn't returned... huh. She 
wasn't over that way, either—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Kh!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Not really... Just taking a walk...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As Admire Vega spoke, a kitten at her feet 
was looking up at her and meowing.
choice_data_list: Is one of the kittens missing?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
The younger sister is gone... She's been 
missing since lunch break.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure she just went looking for food or 
is wandering around, but...
choice_data_list: Shall we look for her together?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: You will...?
choice_data_list:
More hands will make it easier to find 
her.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Alright.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Haaahaha!! In the hands of the "Overlord 
of the Century's End," finding a kitten or 
two will take mere moments!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Mr. Raccoon Dog~, this is what the kitten 
smells like~. Is there anywhere nearby 
that smells like this~?

text_block_list.name: Raccoon Dog
text_block_list.text: *Snuffle, snuffle*...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I agree that having more hands helps, 
but... what is this selection of people...
choice_data_list:
I thought working with familiar faces 
would make coordinating easier.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...Don't blame me if things get out of 
hand.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Come out, Christine~♪ Nothing here will 
ever harm you~♪

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Mr. Raccoon Doooog...! That's not the 
kitten, that's your food, Mr. Raccoon 
Doggg...!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Are you there? Come on out.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Not here either, huh.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, we split up to search for the 
missing kitten, and then—

text_block_list.name: Kitten
text_block_list.text: Nyaan.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that kitten on top of the stage, isn't 
that the one we're looking for~?!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I found you, Christine! Singing upon the 
stage, you truly are an angel...!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Don't give her weird names. ...Honestly.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Don't give her weird names. ...Honestly.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Not really.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Still... thank you for helping out.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
All's well that ends well! Now, let me 
turn the joy in Ayabe-san's heart into a 
song and play a celebratory melody!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
La~la-la~♪ Reunited with my beloved, my 
heart leaps, and roses of joy bloom across 
the entire world~♪

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
............Stop it. Now that the kitten's 
found, I'm leaving.

text_block_list.name: Kittens
text_block_list.text: Myaaon♪

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. I'm glad you two didn't have to 
be separated.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Stay together from now on, alright, 
sisters?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
It's true~. Ayabe-san always helps me 
whenever I mess up, too~.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Enough of that already.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I just—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...Never mind. The kitten's found, so I'm 
leaving.

text_block_list.name: Kittens
text_block_list.text: Myaaon♪

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. I'm glad you two didn't have to 
be separated.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Stay together from now on, alright, 
sisters?
